lines: d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Salvatore Burns is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d41: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d41: 🕯️ Salvatore Burns is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d41: What Salvatore kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d41: "Salvatore's gone." Carmine looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Salvatore." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d41: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Sal blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.

d41: 📖 LEARNED: Diplomatic Incident (Level 1). Trust builds 2x faster. You're TOO good though — once per week you can start a diplomatic incident: villagers argue, you pick the winner (+trust with them, -trust with the loser).
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Reading People (Level 1). Microexpressions leak truth. Watch the eyes, not the mouth. People tell you who they are.
d41: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Deep Read! You don't just read trust — you read intent. Know what they'll do next. (Your knowledge of Reading People amplifies your open_book.)
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Mediation (Level 1). Let each side talk without interruption. Repeat back what you heard. People de-escalate when heard.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Old World Caches (Level 1). You know where people hid things: under floorboards, in hollow trees, behind loose bricks.
d41: 📖 LEARNED: Generous Heart (Level 1). Donating gives 2x trust.
d41: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d41: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Salvatore Burns, 41 days. The mantle passes to Sal Steele.
d41: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Sal Steele, 46 — an interpreter. Their hands know different work now: Beast-calm, Scream Cheese.
d41: The village's quarrel was with Salvatore — and Salvatore is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d41: At the grave, Tyler, Carmine, Mburu and 3 more speak for Sal — "Salvatore trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d41: The fire knew Sal before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.

d72: 🕯️ Sal's funeral feast: 1,500 kcal from the pantry, and every shaken fire is fed — Thornfield. The village mourns together, and the links hold because the dead are honored, not because the grief was forgotten. (Trust mended — the -8 bought back with grain.)
